title: Determinant modular algorithm
statement: For a finite list $z$ of Boolean values, define its output to be the empty list when the integer represented by the decoded first component of $z$ is less than $2$. Otherwise, start from the initial configuration determined by $z$, apply the transition rule $(	ext{length}(z)+1)^2$ times, and return the decoded left component of the resulting configuration.
hypotheses_covered: Input is a finite list of Boolean values
caveat: The supplied snippet does not define the decoding, initial configuration, or transition rule, so their meanings cannot be made self-contained beyond describing their roles in the construction.
